meta.name: nnsight-remote-interpretability
meta.description: Provides guidance for interpreting and manipulating neural network internals using nnsight with optional NDIF remote execution. Use when needing to run interpretability experiments on massive models (70B+) without local GPU resources, or when working with any PyTorch architecture.

copy.tagline: 解读和操控神经网络内部机制
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在无本地GPU条件下分析大模型内部机制。
copy.tagline_en: Interpret and manipulate neural network internals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze large model internals without local GPU.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 nnsight 库读取和修改神经网络内部状态（如隐藏层输出、注意力权重），并支持在本地小模型或远程大模型（70B+）上运行相同的代码。
howto.when: 当你需要分析或干预神经网络内部机制，尤其是处理超大模型（如 70B、405B）且本地 GPU 资源不足时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 nnsight 分析 GPT-2 第5层的隐藏层输出。
say.note: Claude 会生成代码并解释如何获取和保存该层输出。

say.text: 我想在 Llama-3.1-70B 上远程执行激活修补实验。
say.note: Claude 会指导设置 NDIF 远程执行并编写修补代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you use the nnsight library to read and modify neural network internals (e.g., hidden layer outputs, attention weights), and run the same code locally on small models or remotely on large models (70B+).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze or intervene in neural network internals, especially when working with massive models (70B, 405B) without local GPU resources.

say_en.text: Help me analyze the hidden layer output of GPT-2 layer 5 using nnsight.
I want to run an activation patching experiment on Llama-3.1-70B remotely.
